name: Status line
summary: Show your own live info, like context use, cost or git branch, at the bottom of Claude Code.
what: The status line is a bar under the prompt filled by a small script you choose. Claude Code passes it details about the session, and whatever the script prints is shown. It runs on your machine and uses no tokens.

impact.title: Information at a glance
impact.detail: See context use, cost, model or git status without asking.

impact.title: Tell sessions apart
impact.detail: Show the folder or session name when several are open.

impact.title: Free to run
impact.detail: The script runs locally and costs no API usage.

howItWorks: Run /statusline and describe what you want; Claude writes the script and the setting.
Or set statusLine in your settings to a command that reads session JSON on stdin.
The script's printed output becomes the bar.

events.note: Added a customizable status line, set up with /statusline.
